The '''Imperial Enlisted Records''' were the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military's]] records of all enlisted members within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

The name "[[Raina Temple]]" did not exist in their records.
